en.intro: MathsMine3 exposes a JSON HTTP API at mathsmine3.xyz. Public read endpoints are open; mutations typically require a Bearer session from POST /api/auth/session.
en.rateLimitDesc: Public endpoints such as /api/token-value and /api/leaderboard enforce a per-IP limit. X-RateLimit-* headers report quota.

es.intro: MathsMine3 expone una API HTTP JSON en mathsmine3.xyz. Los GET públicos son abiertos; las mutaciones suelen requerir Bearer session de POST /api/auth/session.
es.rateLimitDesc: Endpoints públicos como /api/token-value y /api/leaderboard aplican límite por IP. Las cabeceras X-RateLimit-* informan de la cuota.

endpoints.descEn: Health probe and per-IP rate-limit quota for public endpoints.
endpoints.descEs: Sonda de salud y cuota de rate limit por IP en endpoints públicos.

endpoints.descEn: Macro war/nature %, accent color from top wallet, active and total wallet counts.
endpoints.descEs: Macro guerra/naturaleza %, color de acento del top wallet y contadores de wallets.

endpoints.descEn: Mined blocks, market emojis, and active player positions for the home minimap.
endpoints.descEs: Bloques minados, emojis de mercado y posiciones activas para el minimapa.

endpoints.descEn: List or fetch security scan runs. Query ?limit=20 or ?id=<scanId>.
endpoints.descEs: Lista o detalle de auditorías. Query ?limit=20 o ?id=<scanId>.

endpoints.descEn: Runs the full security audit suite. Requires Authorization: Bearer CRON_SECRET (Vercel cron or manual).
endpoints.descEs: Ejecuta la suite de auditoría. Requiere Authorization: Bearer CRON_SECRET.

endpoints.descEn: Summary of the most recent completed security scan.
endpoints.descEs: Resumen de la última auditoría completada.

endpoints.descEn: Issues a one-time nonce (token + message) for wallet signature login.
endpoints.descEs: Emite un nonce de un solo uso (token + mensaje) para login por firma.

endpoints.descEn: Exchange wallet signature (nonceToken + signature) or Google access_token for a Bearer session token.
endpoints.descEs: Intercambia firma wallet o access_token de Google por un token Bearer de sesión.

endpoints.descEn: Create or ensure a player account (Google or wallet). New accounts per IP are rate-limited (5/day).
endpoints.descEs: Crea o asegura una cuenta (Google o wallet). Nuevas cuentas por IP limitadas (5/día).

endpoints.descEn: Updates wallet last_seen, source, and optional disconnect flag for 3D presence.
endpoints.descEs: Actualiza last_seen, origen y flag de desconexión para presencia 3D.

endpoints.descEn: Latest cumulative MM3 value (updated every minute). Rate-limited per IP; returns X-RateLimit-* headers.
endpoints.descEs: Valor MM3 acumulado más reciente (actualizado cada minuto). Rate limit por IP.

endpoints.descEn: Hourly MM3 value history with per-source breakdown (up to ~83 days).
endpoints.descEs: Histórico horario del valor MM3 con desglose por fuente (~83 días).

endpoints.descEn: Minute-by-minute MM3 value for the last ~75–90 minutes.
endpoints.descEs: Valor MM3 minuto a minuto de los últimos ~75–90 minutos.

endpoints.descEn: NFTJI claims, life continues, and other market events with emoji enrichment.
endpoints.descEs: Claims NFTJI, continuaciones de vida y otros eventos con emoji.

endpoints.descEn: Paginated ranking by MM3 Chain contribution (default limit 50, max 200). Rate-limited per IP.
endpoints.descEs: Ranking paginado por contribución MM3 Chain (límite por defecto 50, máx. 200).

endpoints.descEn: Buy or sell MM3. Server re-derives quotes from DB; client sends mode, currency, amount only. Max 5 trades/day.
endpoints.descEs: Compra o venta MM3. El servidor recalcula cotizaciones; el cliente envía mode, currency, amount. Máx. 5/día.

endpoints.descEn: Claim zero-day trading NFTJI decoration after meeting requirements.
endpoints.descEs: Reclama decoración NFTJI zero-day al cumplir requisitos.

endpoints.descEn: Redeem a relay command penalty with the correct code.
endpoints.descEs: Canjea una penalización de comando relay con el código correcto.

endpoints.descEn: Randomly nudges war/nature macro percentages. Requires session.
endpoints.descEs: Ajusta aleatoriamente los porcentajes macro guerra/naturaleza. Requiere sesión.

endpoints.descEn: Mining world state: blocks, owners, minedBlocks, blockChain progress. Query ?map=1 (lighter), ?details=1, ?wallet=, ?blockKey=.
endpoints.descEs: Estado del mundo 3D: bloques, dueños, minedBlocks, progreso blockChain. Query ?map=1, ?details=1, ?wallet=, ?blockKey=.

endpoints.descEn: Mine a free board block from Relaying when wallet level and global MM3 value meet requirements.
endpoints.descEs: Mina un bloque libre desde Relaying si wallet y valor MM3 global cumplen requisitos.

endpoints.descEn: Resell an owned NFTJI mining block back to the market.
endpoints.descEs: Revende un bloque NFTJI de minado al mercado.

endpoints.descEn: Check and award chain winner when the board is complete. Requires session.
endpoints.descEs: Comprueba y otorga ganador de cadena al completar el tablero. Requiere sesión.

endpoints.descEn: Puzzle status and solver counts. Requires ?wallet=.
endpoints.descEs: Estado del puzzle y contadores de solvers. Requiere ?wallet=.

endpoints.descEn: Submit a chain-solve math answer.
endpoints.descEs: Envía una respuesta matemática del puzzle chain-solve.

endpoints.descEn: Activate demine mode reward after chain completion.
endpoints.descEs: Activa recompensa demine tras completar la cadena.

endpoints.descEn: Status of chain-reset chips (24h cooldown per wallet).
endpoints.descEs: Estado de chips de reset de cadena (cooldown 24h por wallet).

endpoints.descEn: Wipes mm3_mined_blocks via /rm -rf chip. Requires session.
endpoints.descEs: Borra mm3_mined_blocks con chip /rm -rf. Requiere sesión.

endpoints.descEn: Hidden command executor — currently disabled (503 temporarily_disabled) pending wallet auth hardening.
endpoints.descEs: Ejecutor de comandos ocultos — actualmente deshabilitado (503 temporarily_disabled).

endpoints.descEn: Check RL mount node ownership for a wallet.
endpoints.descEs: Comprueba propiedad del nodo RL mount de una wallet.

endpoints.descEn: Purchase RL mount node (costs MM3).
endpoints.descEs: Compra nodo RL mount (cuesta MM3).

endpoints.descEn: Deactivate RL mount for a wallet.
endpoints.descEs: Desactiva RL mount para una wallet.

endpoints.descEn: Current node-dice storm ownership and mode.
endpoints.descEs: Propietario y modo actual del storm node-dice.

endpoints.descEn: Purchase 24h node-dice control (500 MM3, level ≥30).
endpoints.descEs: Compra control node-dice 24h (500 MM3, nivel ≥30).

endpoints.descEn: Get wallet PvP HP. Requires ?wallet=.
endpoints.descEs: Obtiene HP PvP de una wallet. Requiere ?wallet=.

endpoints.descEn: Record PvP hit (attacker → victim). Real wallets require session matching attacker.
endpoints.descEs: Registra golpe PvP. Wallets reales requieren sesión que coincida con attacker.

endpoints.descEn: Check death state and last alive position.
endpoints.descEs: Comprueba estado de muerte y última posición viva.

endpoints.descEn: Persist alive position (row/col/z/mapId) while alive.
endpoints.descEs: Guarda posición viva (row/col/z/mapId) mientras está vivo.

endpoints.descEn: Record death (5-minute cooldown).
endpoints.descEs: Registra muerte (cooldown 5 minutos).

endpoints.descEn: Clear death state when player respawns.
endpoints.descEs: Limpia estado de muerte al reaparecer.

endpoints.descEn: Reward EUR bonus for killing an anonymous player.
endpoints.descEs: Bonificación EUR por matar a un jugador anónimo.

endpoints.descEn: NPC chaser damage (1 HP, rate-limited).
endpoints.descEs: Daño del NPC perseguidor (1 HP, rate limit).

endpoints.descEn: Heal +10 HP in house pool safe zone.
endpoints.descEs: Cura +10 HP en zona segura de la casa pool.

endpoints.descEn: Apply node-dice storm damage during active dice window (409 dice_not_active outside window).
endpoints.descEs: Aplica daño storm node-dice durante ventana activa (409 fuera de ventana).

endpoints.descEn: Public read-only HP/state for the Putin (M3) world boss on map M3.
endpoints.descEs: Lectura pública de HP/estado del boss Putin (M3) en el mapa M3.

endpoints.descEn: Boss-on-player damage while fighting on this map. Requires session wallet matching body.wallet.
endpoints.descEs: Daño del boss al jugador durante el combate. Requiere sesión que coincida con body.wallet.

endpoints.descEn: Player-on-boss damage. Requires session wallet matching body.wallet.
endpoints.descEs: Daño del jugador al boss. Requiere sesión que coincida con body.wallet.

endpoints.descEn: Boss-on-player damage while fighting on this map. Requires session wallet matching body.wallet.
endpoints.descEs: Daño del boss al jugador durante el combate. Requiere sesión que coincida con body.wallet.

endpoints.descEn: Resolve correct training answer (rewards/level).
endpoints.descEs: Resuelve respuesta correcta de training (recompensas/nivel).

endpoints.descEn: Record failed training attempt (penalties).
endpoints.descEs: Registra intento fallido (penalizaciones).

endpoints.descEn: Pay to revive training life after failure.
endpoints.descEs: Paga para revivir vida tras fallo.

endpoints.descEn: Claim training emoji NFTJI reward.
endpoints.descEs: Reclama recompensa emoji NFTJI de training.

endpoints.descEn: Claim daily task reward (training, trading, mining, etc.).
endpoints.descEs: Reclama recompensa de tarea diaria (training, trading, mining, etc.).

endpoints.descEn: Execute relay command between two wallets (initiator must match session).
endpoints.descEs: Ejecuta comando relay entre dos wallets (iniciador = sesión).

endpoints.descEn: Post chat message to relaying terminal.
endpoints.descEs: Publica mensaje en el terminal relaying.
endpoints.curl:
curl -sS -X POST 'https://mathsmine3.xyz/api/relay/chat' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MM3_SESSION' \
  -d '{ "message": "hello IRC" }'

endpoints.descEs: Registra intento de comando relay inválido.

endpoints.descEn: Execute market slash-command (/buy, etc.).
endpoints.descEs: Ejecuta comando slash de mercado (/buy, etc.).

curl -sS -X POST 'https://mathsmine3.xyz/api/relay/market-command' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MM3_SESSION' \
  -d '{ "command": "/buy EUR 0.5" }'

endpoints.descEs: Cron interno del bot: trading, squeezes, simulación 3D. Requiere CRON_SECRET.

endpoints.descEn: Alchemy webhook for ETH/USDC donations. Requires ?token=ALCHEMY_WEBHOOK_TOKEN.
endpoints.descEs: Webhook Alchemy para donaciones ETH/USDC. Requiere ?token=ALCHEMY_WEBHOOK_TOKEN.
